margin floor per SKU / category
price ladder &amp; psychological endings (…9.000 VND)
competitor gap band · MAP / agreed pricing
family and pack-size coherence
max change frequency · max change magnitude
never reprice an item already in a customer's cart" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="128" width="380" x="20" y="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o3" parent="opt" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1" value="MARKDOWN CADENCE

binding constraint · confidence · model_version" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="420" x="880" y="520" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ui" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1" value="Pricing manager queue

and its validator choke point)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="330" x="1360" y="320" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="agent" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="ai-service pricing agent

TIER 0 narrates from a STRUCTURED input
TIER 2 only for scenario Q&amp;A — aggregates only.
Cost prices and margins never leave the rack." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="330" x="1360" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hold" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;fontStyle=1" value="I06 HOLDOUT
a control set of stores × categories stays on manual pricing.
Without it, "+20% revenue" is Amazon's number, not ours." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="330" x="1360" y="670" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="no" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE: personalised per-customer base prices.

Personalised PRICES are a fairness and regulatory problem. 4 of 8 sources — and the only major use case neither earlier plan folder touched." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="1650" x="40" y="800" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ed1" edge="1" div.div:
HARD constraints — reviewable DATA in pricing_rule
margin floor per SKU / category
price ladder & psychological endings (…9.000 VND)
competitor gap band · MAP / agreed pricing
family and pack-size coherence
max change frequency · max change magnitude
never reprice an item already in a customer's cart

div.div:
EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE: personalised per-customer base prices.
Personalised OFFERS through promotion-service are fine and already planned in V05.
Personalised PRICES are a fairness and regulatory problem. Saying so is a maturity signal.

4 of 8 sources — and the only major use case neither earlier plan folder touched.
